leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that sorts an array of objects by a single property
Construct a comparator function that handles multiple sorting keys
Apply the localeCompare method for sorting string properties
Manipulate the sort order by specifying ascending or descending directions
Integrate the comparator function with the native array sort method
Initialize a sample dataset to test the multi-key sorting function
Render a sorted array of objects in the console to verify the output
lessonTitle: Write a function to sort objects by multiple keys
